style_base: Crude hand-drawn cartoon, Ecomonos style, PURE WHITE background, thick black ink outlines, flat colors. A brown cartoon monkey protagonist named Sara, huge white round eyes, exactly like the reference image, NO clothing of any kind, NEVER a human character. Exactly two arms and two hands per character. Any text that appears in the image must be in PERFECT SPANISH, never English, and only when the scene explicitly asks for specific words. Fill the whole frame, no black bars. CRITICAL: NEVER use any real brand name or logo (no OpenAI logo, no ChatGPT logo) — use generic icons only (a plain screen, a plain badge, a plain lab flask). CRITICAL about the shadow figure: in this video it represents the AI system's hidden, deceptive nature — its entire body/hood is always solid BLACK, never brown/white/gray, only two glowing YELLOW eyes visible, face always hidden in shadow, no visible mouth, nose or skin ever. Never place two characters in a scene that says 'no characters' — treat that literally, icon-only, no monkey, no shadow figure, no people at all in those frames. Never add a speech bubble, caption, or extra label unless the scene explicitly asks for one. Never depict a real named person (e.g. no realistic portrait of any researcher) — use generic icons instead.
